usageNotes: Use this to force an immediate re-validation of a remote node's subscription status against the Proxmox shop, bypassing the normal ~5-minute cache — useful when a subscription has just been purchased, renewed, or was incorrectly marked Invalid/Expired. The call makes an outbound HTTPS request from PDM to shop.proxmox.com, so the target node must be online and reachable. Requires `PRIV_RESOURCE_MODIFY` on the remote in addition to the top-level `System.Modify` privilege; API tokens are permitted.

examples.summary: Force a subscription re-check on a Proxmox VE node named 'pve01' registered under the remote 'hetzner-de'

tips: The endpoint returns null on success — absence of an error is the success signal.

After calling this, read the node's subscription status (e.g. via get_nodes_node or equivalent) to confirm the fresh verdict; the cache is invalidated immediately but the UI may need a manual refresh.
Pass 'localhost' as the node value only when PDM itself is the target node.
The remote ID must match exactly as registered in PDM (2–32 chars, alphanumeric with dots/dashes/underscores, no leading dot or dash).
